properties.name: United Kingdom
properties.comment: This includes Great Britain and Northern Ireland, but not the Isle of Man or Channel Islands. See Britain and Ireland for a larger extract of the region. Note that while the Falklands and Bermuda are listed under "Sub Regions" below for convenience, their data is not contained in the United Kingdom file itself.
